statement: Agriculture vulnerability is high nationwide and very high in Savanes; under RCP6.0, Kara also reaches very high by 2050.
compact_statement: Agriculture vulnerability is high nationwide and very high in Savanes; under RCP6.0, Kara also reaches very high by 2050.

source_refs.locator: Executive summary, printed p. iii (PDF p. 3), agriculture vulnerability by region.

uncertainty: Indices summarize cited studies; no uncertainty intervals are stated.

statement: Communication reports retreat along 40 km of sandy coast at an average 10 m yearly, aggravated by storms and local sediment dynamics.
compact_statement: Communication reports retreat along 40 km of sandy coast at an average 10 m yearly, aggravated by storms and local sediment dynamics.

source_refs.locator: Section 2.3.4.1, printed p. 50 (PDF p. 61), coastal erosion and shoreline change.

uncertainty: The communication cites WACA ResIP-Togo coastal research for this measurement.

statement: Under RCP6.0, sea level is projected to rise 11.35 cm by 2025 and 62 cm by 2100, worsening coastal erosion and livelihood risks.
compact_statement: Under RCP6.0, sea level is projected to rise 11.35 cm by 2025 and 62 cm by 2100, worsening coastal erosion and livelihood risks.

source_refs.locator: Section 2.3.4.1, printed p. 50 (PDF p. 61), sea-level projection summary.

uncertainty: Reproduced from Togo's 2019 national communication; 2025 remains a dated projection, not an observed sea level.

statement: NDC links prolonged drought in recent decades with recurring farmer-herder conflicts in the Savanes and Plateaux livestock areas.
compact_statement: NDC links prolonged drought in recent decades with recurring farmer-herder conflicts in the Savanes and Plateaux livestock areas.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.2.2.2, PDF pp. 50-51 (one-based), livestock vulnerability and farmer-herder conflict.

uncertainty: Report states recurring conflict alongside drought but provides no causal event analysis.

statement: Under RCP6.0 to 2030, water stocks rise in Mono but fall in Oti and Lake Togo; NDC warns inaction may heighten water-source conflict risk.
compact_statement: Under RCP6.0 to 2030, water stocks rise in Mono but fall in Oti and Lake Togo; NDC warns inaction may heighten water-source conflict risk.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.2.3, PDF pp. 51-52 (one-based), basin water projections and source-conflict risk.

uncertainty: Modeled basin changes and stated conflict risk are not a forecast of violent incidents.

statement: NDC reports 2020-2021 Oti and Mono floods caused deaths and damaged roads, markets, health centers, homes, schools, power and telecoms.
compact_statement: NDC reports 2020-2021 Oti and Mono floods caused deaths and damaged roads, markets, health centers, homes, schools, power and telecoms.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.2.4, PDF p. 52 (one-based), Oti and Mono flood impacts in 2020 and 2021.

uncertainty: NDC summarizes impacts without event-level loss totals.

statement: NDC estimates 6,902 hectares of food crops flooded in 2020 and production losses near 9,000 tonnes; dry spells also reduced yields.
compact_statement: NDC estimates 6,902 hectares of food crops flooded in 2020 and production losses near 9,000 tonnes; dry spells also reduced yields.

source_refs.locator: Section 4.2.2.2, PDF p. 50 (one-based), 2020 crop losses from flooding and dry spells.
